title: Tensorization is a powerful but underexplored tool for compression and interpretability of neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2505.20132v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tensorizing a neural network involves reshaping some or all of its dense weight matrices into higher-order tensors and approximating them using low-rank tensor network decompositions. This technique has shown promise as a model compression strategy for large-scale neural networks. However, despite encouraging empirical results, tensorized neural networks (TNNs) remain underutilized in mainstream deep learning. In this position paper, we offer a perspective on both the potential and current limitations of TNNs. We argue that TNNs represent a powerful yet underexplored framework for deep learning--one that deserves greater attention from both engineering and theoretical communities. Beyond compression, we highlight the value of TNNs as a flexible class of architectures with distinctive scaling properties and increased interpretability. translated_title: 张量化是一种强大但尚未被充分探索的神经网络压缩与可解释性工具
translated_abstract: 对神经网络进行张量化是指将其部分或全部稠密权重矩阵重塑为高阶张量，并使用低秩张量网络分解对其进行近似。该技术作为大规模神经网络的模型压缩策略已展现出良好前景。然而，尽管实证结果令人鼓舞，张量化神经网络（TNNs）在主流深度学习中仍未得到充分利用。在这篇立场论文中，我们对TNNs的潜力和当前局限性提出了见解。我们认为，TNNs代表了一个强大但尚未被充分探索的深度学习框架——一个值得工程界和理论界给予更多关注的框架。除了压缩之外，我们强调了TNNs作为一类具有独特扩展特性和更高可解释性的灵活架构的价值。TNNs的一个核心特征是键指数的存在，它引入了新的潜在空间……
tldr: 本文提出张量化神经网络（TNNs）是一种强大但未被充分探索的深度学习框架，它不仅能实现模型压缩，还具有独特的扩展特性和更高的可解释性，值得工程界和理论界的更多关注。
en_tdlr: This position paper argues that tensorized neural networks (TNNs) constitute a powerful yet underexplored deep learning framework offering not only model compression but also distinctive scaling properties and enhanced interpretability, deserving greater attention from both engineering and theoretical communities.
